name: NHS AI Lab Skunkworks: Bed Allocation
what_it_is: A proof-of-concept ML tool for Kettering General Hospital that suggests optimal bed assignments for incoming patients using a greedy allocation agent and constraint-based rules, with a Plotly Dash web UI.
measurement: Constraint satisfaction reporting per bed suggestion
modes: MCTS allocation (implemented but excluded from UI)
constraints: No trained models or real data included
MCTS excluded from UI due to performance
Constraints binary only; no weighted balancing
